title: 2025 Annual Report: Strengthening Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) and Mortality Data Systems in Uganda
why_not: Its one dated fact on a gap aspect, the late-2025 digital birth and death notification registers, is stated more fully in the October-December 2025 quarterly it summarises (lead 2); the rest is death notification and cause-of-death certification in DHIS2, not registration at an office.
